specificFindings: Chocolate is an analogy for experiential complexity, not a diet or health experiment; rich is not financial wealth.
The self-report easy/happy/meaningful contrast retains tend and not necessarily; no correlation-to-guaranteed-causation conversion.
Epigenetic claim is attributed to some researchers and retains claimed/suggesting; expression is not DNA-code or gene-count change.
The nature/nurture discussion is an analogy, not evidence that happiness is purely inherited.
Window repair is a family narrative; fixed mindset is the son’s comment, not a clinical diagnosis.
Batting-average equivalence is limited to that measure, not runs or every baseball metric; the advice links to frequent small pleasant interactions.
William James chain/anchorage language is philosophical metaphor, not a measured formula or guarantee against adversity.
So it goes and The fragility of happiness are genuine short source units; no new English clauses are invented.
Questions30,45,49 explicitly include the source context needed to support contextual meanings; overlap with already evidenced adjacent IDs is not counted twice.
